claim.summary: For a finite field F_q contained in K, v>=1 and 0<=k<v, the least degree of a nonzero f in K[x_1,...,x_v] whose formal restriction f(Ut+c) is zero for every rank-k U over F_q and c in F_q^v is q(q^(k+1)-1)/(q-1). A smallest-dimensional nonzero affine restriction is divisible by every rational affine hyperplane of that space; projecting to k+1 coordinates and multiplying all its affine hyperplane forms attains equality. Joint restriction is injective below that degree. Formal vanishing, not just finite-point evaluation; k=v has no nonzero example.
claim.assessment: Working all-parameter minimal-restriction and explicit-product proof, passed by the sole medium reviewer. No efficient reconstruction or Frege lower bound asserted.

formalization.scope: Informal proof or computation; no Lean verification.

significance.rationale: Sharp general geometric calibration for a common-mask mechanism; point-vanishing and multiplicity results have distinct hypotheses.
significance.next_action: Use the exact mask threshold when assessing a collective affine-slice certificate invariant; do not infer global hardness from detection alone.

claim.summary: For a binary full certificate C and scalar patch C'=A+MC, if restriction to every binary affine k-flat fixes placeholders and gives rho(C')=rho(A), then any nonzero M has degree at least 2^(k+2)-2. A size-S depth-d division-free arithmetic circuit for M counting gates and wires, with scalar/variable leaves and no succinct powers, has S^d>=2^(k+2)-2. Fixed depth and k=omega(log N) exclude polynomial-size nonzero masks; for rank m=2n, k=n gives an exponential mask bound. Zero M, other patch forms and certificate/Frege size lower bounds are not excluded or proved.
claim.assessment: Working consequence of formal affine-flat vanishing and the elementary circuit-degree bound, passed by the sole medium reviewer. Scoped to nonzero common multipliers.

formalization.scope: Informal proof or computation; no Lean verification.

significance.rationale: At the rank candidate's parameters, rules out cheap simultaneous erasure by this nonzero scalar mask while leaving actual refutation complexity unchanged.
significance.next_action: Scheduled goal review must compare collective compatibility against alternative complete routes; this mask lower bound is not a refutation lower bound.

claim.summary: If P over F_2 in n variables has Hasse multiplicity >= k at all nonzero points and exactly l < k at the origin, then deg P >= 2k or P = F P' with F the product of the 2^n-1 affine forms 1+u.x, P' of multiplicity >= k-2^(n-1) at nonzero points and exactly l at the origin; so delta(n,c,0) >= min(2c, 2^n-1+delta(n,c-2^(n-1),0)).
claim.assessment: Working proof: restriction to each origin-avoiding hyperplane lies in (y)^k of the hyperplane (origin-jet lemma), so it is 0 or of degree >= 2k.

formalization.scope: Informal proof or computation; no Lean verification.

significance.rationale: A lower-bound mechanism paying for blocks of 2^(n-1) multiplicity, complementary to the one-dimension step.

claim.summary: For a binary quadratic input tuple F on v variables and any supplied Hilbert-like refutation C, every injective binary affine embedding psi(t)=Ut+c with k parameters has a fixed circuit A independent of C such that M=1+A(x,F,b) vanishes on the slice and C'=A+MC is a Hilbert-like refutation with C'(psi(t),Y,Z)=A(psi(t),Y,Z). Explicit parameter-cube selectors and quadratic monomial telescoping construct Boolean corrections; a left inverse V transports parameter Boolean placeholders to VZ using b(psi(t))=U b(t). From input size u/depth Delta and certificate size S/depth d, size is O(S+u+a+v(k+1)+2^k(k+1)^3), depth at most max(d,Delta+8)+2. Coefficient degree L increases to at most L+k+2. Rank-family fixed slices with k=O(log N) consequently have cheap full-certificate data after a polynomial-overhead patch. No simultaneous-all-slice, adaptive-slice, exact simulation-image or unconditional small-refutation assertion.
claim.assessment: Working exact selector, affine-left-inverse and residual-patch proof with explicit Boolean placeholders and circuit cost, passed by the sole medium reviewer. Fixed-slice and supplied-certificate scope retained.
